scenarios.name: no_keyring_enter_openrouter_and_test
events:
Welcome to AccessiWeather.

Step 1 of 3: Add your first location now?

If you already have settings or API keys to bring over, choose Import existing.

Choose Configure myself, or press Escape, to close this wizard and set things up later.

Your system keyring is not available.

API keys you enter cannot be stored securely on this machine. On Linux, installing a keyring backend (e.g. gnome-keyring or KWallet) is recommended.

You can still enter keys now; if portable mode is enabled with an encrypted bundle they will be saved there — otherwise they will be lost on exit.

Step 2 of 3: Enter your OpenRouter API key now, or leave blank to skip.

Choose Set up now to enter or get a key, Skip this key to keep going, or Configure myself to close the wizard.
